test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Find the value of the following.

frac{{sin 67^circ cos 37^circ - sin 37^circ cos 67^circ }}{{cos 13^circ cos 17^circ - sin 13^circ sin 17^circ }}
solution:
**Given:**

frac{{sin 67^circ cos 37^circ - sin 37^circ cos 67^circ }}{{cos 13^circ cos 17^circ - sin 13^circ sin 17^circ }}

**Concept used:**

CosA CosB - SinA SinB = Cos(A + B)

Sinθ = Cos(90 - θ)

**Calculations:**

[Sin67° Cos37° - Sin37° Cos67°] ÷ [Cos13° Cos17° - Sin13° Sin17°]

⇒ [Cos23° Cos37° - Sin37° Sin23°] ÷ [Cos13° + 17°]

⇒ Cos(23° + 37°) ÷ Cos(13° + 17°)

⇒ Cos 60°/Cos 30° 

⇒ 1/2 ÷ √3/2 = 1/√3 

**∴ The value of given equation is 1/√3.**
